[SWS_PHM_00220]
{DRAFT}
Switch Global Supervision Status from
kDEACTI-
VATED
to
kOK
⌈
If the
Global Supervision Status
is
kDEACTIVATED
, the
Ele-
mentary Supervision Status
of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervi-
sion is
kOK
and no supervision is in
Elementary Supervision Status kFAILED
or
kEXPIRED
, then the
Platform Health Management
shall change the
Global
Supervision Status
to
kOK
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111)
See transition (2) in figure 7.6.
